lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing distorted synth bass, vocoder harmony, snaps]

[Verse 1: clipped, tense, low in the range]
Porch light off, engine low
You and me and no one's supposed to know
Your jacket's on my chair again
Tell them we were only ever friends

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, backing voices answer]
And I know better (I know)
I've read the weather (I know)
The leaves are turning and so are we

[Chorus: wide synths, stacked vocals]
It's a reckless October
Got me running stop signs sober
Saying "this is the last time"
With your hands in my coat
Oh, whoa
It's a reckless October
And I don't want it over

[Verse 2: clipped, tense, a little faster]
Kitchen clock, quarter to
Every lie I tell is one for you
I'm too grown for hiding in a car
Doing it anyway, and here we are

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, backing voices answer]
And I know better (I know)
I've read the weather (I know)
The leaves are turning and so are we

[Chorus: wide synths, stacked vocals]
It's a reckless October
Got me running stop signs sober
Saying "this is the last time"
With your hands in my coat
Oh, whoa
It's a reckless October
And I don't want it over

[Bridge: shouted, breathless, drums pounding, no pause for breath]
I'm barefoot in your drive at three, I laughed till I couldn't breathe
Said "I'm fine," I wasn't fine, meant every word, crossed every line
And I shouted from the kerb
"I think I'm in this for real," and the whole street heard
You looked back laughing like you already knew
Of course you did, you do

[Final Chorus: biggest, vocoder on top, crowd shouting]
It's a reckless October
Got me running stop signs sober
Saying "this is the last time"
With your hands in my coat
Oh, whoa
It's a reckless October
And I don't want it over

[Outro: synth bass alone, one vocoder note]
I don't want it over
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 170 BPM with the pulse felt at 85, 4/4, A major. Tense in the verses, wide open in the chorus, frantic in the bridge.

VOICE: Female soprano, bright and conversational. Verses are clipped and low, almost muttered. The chorus is stacked wide with high harmonies. The bridge is shouted in one breathless run with a crack of laughter in it. A vocoder doubles some lines with a robotic shimmer.

INSTRUMENTS: A pulsing, distorted synth bass. Bright, wide synthesiser chords. A vocoder used as a harmony instrument. A tight drum machine with a big snare. Finger snaps in the verses. A glittering high arpeggio in the chorus. A recorded crowd in the final chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, synth bass and vocoder. 0:11 Verse 1. 0:34 Pre-chorus. 0:45 Chorus 1. 1:13 Verse 2. 1:36 Pre-chorus. 1:47 Chorus 2. 2:15 Bridge, shouted over pounding drums in one run. 2:34 Final chorus with the crowd. 3:02 Outro, the synth bass alone and one vocoder note at 3:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s synth-pop: glossy and wide with a dirty bass at the centre, vocals bright, the bridge left raw and loud.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The bridge at 2:15, written to be shouted by a crowd in one breath.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: 'I'm too grown for hiding in a car, doing it anyway.' The secrecy belongs to people with kitchens, clocks and other people to consider, which makes the shouted confession braver.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Secrecy, giddiness, a blurted truth, relief.
